# skyphusion.org

> Skyphusion Labs: free AGPL open source tools you own. Not for sale.
> Product focus: Vivijure + Postern. Also Prism, Hollow Grid, tooling.

## Flagship
- Vivijure (self-hosted AI film studio, Studio 1.0 open train): https://vivijure.dev
- Vivijure constellation: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/vivijure
- Postern (email for humans and agents): https://posternonline.com
- Postern source: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/postern
- Postern demo: https://demo.posternonline.com

## Play
- Prism (multimodal, public BYOK): https://play.skyphusion.org
- Prism source: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/prism

## Worlds
- The Hollow Grid: https://hollow.skyphusion.org
- Dustfall: https://dustfall.skyphusion.org
- Rust Choir (Go) and Verdigris Spool (Python) world ports: offline, moving to containers
- mud-bots: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/mud-bots

## Tooling
- crew-bus (cross-agent / cross-context MCP message bus, self-host): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/crew-bus
- security-audit (MIT): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/security-audit
- search-mcp: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/search-mcp
- SidVicious_exe: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/SidVicious_exe
- Slate (Discord screenwriter for Vivijure): https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/slate

## WordPress
- Skyphusion AI (WordPress plugin, live on WordPress.org): https://wordpress.org/plugins/skyphusion-ai/
- WordPress on Cloudflare: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/wordpress-on-cloudflare
- Zaraz Consent: https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/zaraz-consent
- GGC store: https://ggc.sh

## In development
- A forex trading bot on MetaTrader 4 (no public link yet)

## Research (maintenance)
